dedupe_keys.name: europe icu capacity data and r code for mrc j idea covid 19 report 36 on icu spare capacity under epidemic scenarios in france germany and italy

description: This repository holds the data and R scripts behind Report 36 of the MRC Centre and the Jameel Institute (MRC/J-IDEA) COVID-19 report series, which modelled intensive care unit capacity under different COVID-19 epidemic scenarios in three western European countries. The archived copies read on 2026-09-28 through Software Heritage, under both the jameel-institute and j-idea accounts, share a last change of October 2021, made for a second round of journal revisions. The repository has calibration files, folders of spare ICU capacity results for France, Germany and Italy, and a folder on communicating uncertainty; the French folder alone holds R data files for a base case and for trigger scenarios combining reproduction numbers with intervention durations from 7 to 42 days. Coverage is France, Germany and Italy for the COVID-19 pandemic. Access is free; no licence file was seen in the repository root, and the model code itself was not read. Caveats: outputs are stored as R data files, and the report text is needed to interpret scenario names. It supports hospital surge capacity studies, such as testing how long ICUs can absorb an epidemic wave before an intervention is triggered. No related ICU capacity record is catalogued.
licence: not stated in the repository root
